title: Safety Playbook: Immediate Victim First-Response & Incident Remediation
source: ScamShield AI Incident Response & Cyber Safety Advisory
content:
When an individual suspects they have interacted with a fraudulent message, disclosed credentials, or authorized an unauthorized transaction, swift execution of containment protocols is critical.

1. Immediate Containment Checklist (First 15-30 Minutes):
- Freeze Financial Channels: Immediately contact the issuing bank's official fraud helpline or use official mobile banking apps to freeze debit/credit cards, disable net banking access, and block UPI transactions.
- Report to Cybercrime Authorities: In India, dial 1930 immediately or log on to cybercrime.gov.in. Providing transaction reference numbers (UTR, transaction ID) within the first hour dramatically improves the rate of inter-bank fund recovery.
- Disconnect Device If Remote Software Installed: If remote desktop applications (AnyDesk, TeamViewer) were installed, immediately disconnect the device from Wi-Fi and mobile data, uninstall the application, and boot into safe mode or factory reset.

2. Credential Invalidation & Hygiene:
- Change passwords for banking portals, primary email accounts, and mobile carrier accounts from an uncompromised secondary device.
- Terminate all active web sessions ('Log out of all devices') across critical identity providers (Google, Microsoft, Apple ID).
- Verify SMS forwarding settings on the mobile device (dial carrier codes like ##002# in India to clear unconditional call/SMS diverts).

3. Evidence Preservation:
- Capture screenshots of the fraudulent message, sender phone numbers, SMS sender headers, payment transfer receipts, and associated web links before deleting them.
